_about: Unified calibration + measurement corpus for the local cloud-egress anonymizer gate (scripts/dev/anonymizer_gate.py). Fictional data only. Schema: one JSON document with a top-level "entries" list. Each entry has: "id" (unique slug); "lang" (ISO 639-1); "casing" ("cased" or "lower" -- whether the whole utterance is lowercased); "kind" (one of device_command, kinship_question, name_mention, contact_info, place_org_product, mixed, assistant_reply, transcript, dense, planted, document, facts); "description" (plain-language, what the entry exercises); "speaker_id"/"speaker_name" (nullable -- the session's own speaker); "history" (a list of {role, text} prior turns, empty for a single utterance); "text" (the current turn, present for every kind except facts) or "facts" (a list of {subject, predicate, object, relation_type, confidence, speaker_id} objects, present only for kind facts); "gold" (one entry per occurrence: {value, category, turn, start, end} -- category is a configs/schema.yaml anonymizer.prefixes row name; turn is -1 for "text", i for "history[i]", or the string "facts" for a facts-kind entry, whose start/end are relative to the rendered fact-lines text paramem.cloud.anonymize.render_fact_lines(facts) produces -- the same text the SCAN call reads for a facts-shaped anonymize() call); "decoys" (values that must not be scrubbed, scored as named junk if they are).

entries.description: The same first name spoken twice with different capitalisation (sentence-initial vs. mid-sentence), plus a second person's name. Exercises that both casings of the same name are recognised as the same person and share one placeholder rather than minting two.

history.text: Lena said she would come by at six.
Which Lena -- the one from the choir?

entries.description: A German surname appearing in four grammatical forms in one conversation: the full name once, the genitive form twice, and the bare dative surname once, plus an email address built from the same surname. Exercises a known residual: the anonymizer matches exact surfaces only, so the inflected surname forms are not caught by the same match as the full name and can reach the outbound text verbatim even though the full name and the email are correctly scrubbed.
